text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean quantile score (points of capacity) by lead band on the rows outside switching events at the five decision substations. F1 and F2 are the two fitting directions (solid and dashed). GAM-0 is experiment 111's convex model without the Kalman filter, on the same rows.'
text.tspan: Mean quantile score (points of capacity) by lead band on the rows outside switching events at
the five decision substations. F1 and F2 are the two fitting directions (solid and dashed).
GAM-0 is experiment 111's convex model without the Kalman filter, on the same rows.
